purpose: Phase 3F.1.2 - consolidated structural-integrity results: the 16 invariants (I1-I16), which test(s) assert each, and the known-package aggregate outcome.

invariants.description: No two source occurrences share nodeId within one document.
Duplicate sectionRef/label values are allowed and expected.
Duplicate legal-reference candidates are represented as a set, never collapsed to one.
Parent-child ownership uses occurrence identity, never label.
No silent map overwrite on identity collision.
No child-list merging across distinct occurrences.
Every indexed node is retrievable by nodeId.
Own-text boundary only ever consults the node's own (occurrence-correct) children.
Every indexed node is reachable via traversal from its root, except explicit orphans.
Orphaned nodes are explicit, never silently re-rooted or dropped.
Cycles are impossible by construction, and explicitly detected if synthesized.
Source spans satisfy deterministic validity checks (bounds + parent nesting).
assertedBy: structural-node-identity-invariants.test.ts > I12 (4 cases including the new OVERLAPPING_INCOMPATIBLE_SPAN check)

invariants.description: Sibling ordering is source order (charStart ascending).
Document boundary is part of the identity domain.
Ambiguous legal-reference lookups return multiple candidates, never a silent pick.
Structural-health diagnostics surface every invariant violation as a named, queryable condition.

structuralHealthFindingCodesImplemented: MULTIPLE_STRUCTURAL_PARENTS (declared, structurally unreachable under the current single-parentNodeId-field data model)

testFileSummary.structural-node-identity-property.test.t: 13 tests, 13 passed (includes the 1500-case seeded fuzz loop)
